intent: Inspect and refactor TelemetryEventBus without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Shared kernel of Intake/Ledger integration. Port of the bounded in-process reactive bridge. publish emits one event to subscribers without blocking, completing when accepted and erroring when the overflow strategy rejects; stream returns a hot, backpressure-aware Flux of all events (subscribers see events published after subscribing). Ledger depends only on this port, never on Intake internals.
